input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision is one-directional: section 2(d) confirms TrueLink's rights in the Interface (which is acceptable), but nothing confirms that we retain ownership of Client Content, Client Intellectual Property or our borrower/loan data, and nothing addresses ownership of or a licence to the work product produced under the Support Services (section 4 programmer deliverables). The only Client-side ownership language is incidental — section 13 says we "shall retain full ownership of all domains associated with Client and Client Content" on discontinuation of Hosting Service — and section 10 merely treats Client's Intellectual Property and "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" as our Proprietary Information for confidentiality purposes, which is not an ownership or licence grant. With no ownership of, or perpetual licence to, the deliverables we pay for and no Customer Data ownership statement, the clause set fails even the fallback, so we have inserted a reciprocal Client ownership provision (assignment of Work Product, licence back for embedded TrueLink IP, no joint ownership) immediately after the existing Ownership clause. Noted but not separately redlined: section 8(d) grants TrueLink a broad licence to exploit "Credit Data" — that is a term-limited licence over narrowly defined raw third-party credit data (archived and not combined with Client Proprietary Information) subject to the Non-Competition Agreement, not an assignment of our data, so it sits within the negotiated bargain.

proposal.summary: Add Client ownership of Client Content, Client Intellectual Property, Client data and Support Services work product, with assignment from TrueLink and a licence back for embedded TrueLink IP; no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Ownership clause only confirms TrueLink's rights in the Interface and is silent on what we contribute and pay for, so we have added a matching sentence confirming that we retain all rights in Client Content, Client Intellectual Property and our borrower and loan data, and that work product from the Support Services is ours (with TrueLink assigning and licensing any of its embedded IP). This reflects our position that we own what we pay for and what we put in, and that no joint ownership is created; TrueLink's ownership of the Interface is unaffected.

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. As between the parties, Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, the Client Intellectual Property and all data of Client and its borrowers, loan applicants, customers and brokers that is submitted to or processed through the Interface or the Web Site. All results, deliverables and work product prepared by TrueLink for Client under the Support Services (the "Work Product") shall be owned by Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all of its right, title and interest in and to the Work Product; to the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in the Work Product, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such TrueLink Intellectual Property as part of the Work Product in Client's business. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to TrueLink any ownership of the Client Content, the Client Intellectual Property or such data, and no jointly owned intellectual property is created hereunder.
